rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese comparative marker, placed after the comparison word or phrase.

example.english: This shop is cheaper than that one.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 peng4 gwo3 go2 gaan1

rows.note: Use this in the alternative 比 construction, with the comparison basis before the adjective or quantity.

example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 bei2 cam4 jat6 dung3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for ordinary comparisons, with the adjective before 過.

example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 bou6 faai3 gwo3 nei5

rows.note: Use this straightforward alternative when presenting B as the standard of comparison before the description.

example.english: This shop is cheaper than that one.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 dim3 bei2 go2 gaan1 peng4

rows.note: Use 多過 for quantities, amounts, ages, durations, and counts meaning “more than.”

example.english: There are more than five people in their household.
example.traditional: 佢哋屋企有多過五個人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jau5 do1 gwo3 ng5 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use 少過 when the comparison means “less than” or “fewer than,” especially with quantities and counts.

example.english: There are fewer than ten seats here.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 dak1 siu2 gwo3 sap6 go3 wai2
